dataList.content:
We took Wang Qingshan's remaining coins.
我们得到了王清山剩下的铜钱。
dataList.place:
Evaluation Arena 1F - Lab Ruins
评审场1层 实验室废墟

dataList.content:
Well, that's not a lot of coins. But hey, it's still...
虽然没几个……不过也还好……

If I fail here miserably... having accomplished nothing... they might kill me when I get home...
如果就这么落选……我就算回去了也很快就会死……

I have to do something, anything... to be a proud sister to my little siblings...
如果不做出什么成绩来……就没脸去见弟弟了……

Come on, let's leave her and keep moving. It's not like getting eliminated is an instant death sentence.
直接无视这家伙吧。反正落选后也不会死不是么。

You... you don't understand, Jia Baoyu...
你……你不会明白的，贾宝玉……

You've done nothing but watch all your life... as this fight defined our entire lives...
一生中只是旁观一切的你……对我们不得不背负一生去进行的战斗……

No, I don't understand.
没错，我不明白。

And I never will.
今后大概也会如此。

Without a reply, she shambled out to the hallways, weeping.
她抽泣着，蹒跚地通过走廊离开了。

... So all that passivity and talk about not getting angry wasn't because you're a nice guy, huh.
……所以，你并不是因为人好，才不生气。

You're more difficult than I thought, Hong Lu.
你比我想象中更加复杂呢，鸿璐先生。

Mm, am I?
唔，是这样吗？

It's getting more and more likely that we'll be running into the other candidates as the space around us shrinks.
空间缩小的话，之后碰到其他候选人的概率应该会变高吧。

Yeah. And another thing—it's getting clearer every second that the biggest threat to us now continues to be...
没错，不过目标也更明确了。我们之后最需要注意的敌人是……

... Jia Qiu...
贾丘……唯有那人。

Let's hope we never run into that guy...
只能全力祈祷不要遇到他了……

Ohhhh~ So that's it, huh? We have our twelfth elimination!
啊~已经进展到这一步了？第十二位落选者已经出现了！

Yeah... then all the mediocre candidates must've been eliminated by now. The remaining ones gotta be a tough bunch.
确实……三流货色全部落选后，剩下的就是相对有力的候选人了。

Anyways... there certainly are a lot of posters around the lab here.
不过，这实验室……好像四处都贴着海报。

They were gonna present the research to the public, huh?
是预定在公众面前发表实验结果吗？

Yes, they were.
是的，没错。

Puff... Typical. I guess researchers just can't help showing off their achievements, huh.
呼……大概是研究者们按捺不住想要向别人展示研究成果吧。

Well, too bad the Sweepers 'n the Claws tore through everything. Even the posters— Hang on a minute. Why are these posters untouched?
不过，不是说过那什么清道夫还是爪牙来着，已经把一切都破坏掉了吗。那海报内容也……哈？怎么回事？这不还好好留着吗？

... They did not destroy the posters.
……他们并没有破坏这些海报。

Once they are put to task, they are extremely thorough with erasing any evidence of the Taboo ever having existed. But the fact that these posters remain...
但凡和禁忌有一缕联系都会被他们彻底抹除，如此一来，他们保留这些海报的原因……

... would lead to the conclusion that the experiment advertised on these posters is an entirely different one from the experiment that broke the Taboo.
应该是这些海报中公布的实验与结果和禁忌毫无关联。

What?! Then how...?
什么？！那为什么……

Simple.
很简单。

This experiment is unrelated to the annihilation of the Kong family.
这份实验与孔家灭门之日的原因无关。

Then this Jia Mu must've prepared an entirely separate experiment using the Kong family's support. With an escape plan just for herself, too.
也就是说这个贾母……借了孔家之手准备了其他实验，还制定了能让自己脱身的某种计划。

... I remember those posters...
……我还记得那些海报……

And how excited everyone was the closer we got to the presentation.
随着发布日临近，我们都十分兴奋。

Boluses made by the Kong family always performed beyond everyone's expectations, after all.
因为孔家制作的丸……无论何时都远超大家的期待。

Venerable Jia Mu, may I ask why you continue to bring young master Baoyu to this place?
恕我好奇，老太太您为何每次都带着宝玉少爷过来？
dataList.place:
Hongyuan's Laboratory, Past
过去，鸿园的实验室

dataList.content:
I don't think he's even old enough to understand what these experiments are for. Not to mention it must be quite troublesome for you.
少爷太过年幼，想必理解不了实验的内容，带他来也只是徒增麻烦吧。

You ask a question with an obvious answer.
这疑问的答案显而易见。

This experiment will define the destiny of Hongyuan itself.
因为这实验重要到能决定鸿园的命运。

It is only right that the jade of Daguanyuan is here to witness such a great undertaking.
如此重要的场合，大观园之玉自然需要在场。

... I see.
……我明白了。

Huh, now that I'm looking at young master Baoyu...
可宝玉少爷他……

He's not much of a smiler, is he?
为何完全不笑呢？

He'd look much better with a smile on his face. He's the precious jade of the family, after all.
既然是家中珍贵的玉，面露笑容不是更好看吗。

His existence itself is precious—this jade shall shine when the time is right.
他的存在本身就有所价值，待时机一到，自然会焕发光彩。

In the meantime, draw your focus entirely to the experiment.
你应在意的是那份实验。
Right, I see what you mean. Not this experiment, but the experiment. 我明白您的意思了。并不是这份，而是“那份实验”吧。

That reminds me that we really don't have much time.
您这么一提，时间确实所剩无几了。

They say that every clan under the Kong family is quite excited about the announcement.
据说孔家的势力，无一例外都满心期待着发布日。

Yes, indeed... The time is nigh.
没错……时间所剩无几。

The time is nigh indeed.
时机将至。
